structured_output.mechanisms: Time ≈ 0.5s plus samples processed (epochs×50k) times per-sample cost, which is affine in conv MACs (stage widths at 32², 16², 8² resolution), cut by low-res phases in proportion to pixel count; cutout and Muon add overhead. Accuracy rises logarithmically with epochs and with width (last block most), is helped by light augmentation (translate2) and label smoothing 0.1, Muon, and hurt by cutout and low-res phases. Batch size has little effect at equal epochs.
